description: The one writer for a token_store='state' hosted-MCP OAuth token: refreshes via the stored refresh_token and uploads a new version to Dagster's defs_state_storage. Emits a job (not an asset), with an optional inline cron schedule.

outputs.description: A plain op/job -- no data value. Side effect: a new token version written to defs_state_storage.

job_name.label: Job Name
job_name.description: Dagster job name for the refresher.

state_key.label: State Key
state_key.description: The defs_state_storage key to refresh -- must match the --state-key used at sign-in (mcp_oauth_login) and the consuming component's own state_key (e.g. HostedMcpServerComponent).

cron_schedule.label: Cron Schedule
cron_schedule.description: Optional cron expression (e.g. '0 */4 * * *' for every 4 hours). When set, a ScheduleDefinition fires this job on this cadence -- pick something comfortably inside the access token's own lifetime (commonly ~1-8h). Leave unset to trigger this job some other way (your own schedule/sensor).

default_status.label: Default Status
default_status.description: Status of the emitted schedule (cron_schedule only). Defaults to 'running', unlike most schedules in this repo -- an un-started refresher silently defeats this component's entire purpose.
